title: Magento
description: Enables user authentication through magento and agent interface widgets.

settings_def.name: url
settings_def.label: Magento URL
settings_def.description: This is the URL to your Magento site (without any trailing slash).

settings_def.name: api_user
settings_def.label: Magento API User
settings_def.description: Enter the name of an API user that you setup in Magento via System > Web Services > SOAP/XML-RPC - Users.

settings_def.name: api_key
settings_def.label: Magento API Key
settings_def.description: Enter the API key for your user.

settings_def.name: widget_ticket
settings_def.label: Enable Ticket Widget
settings_def.description: Show the Magento widget on tickets

settings_def.name: widget_profile
settings_def.label: Enable Profile Widget
settings_def.description: Show the Magento widget on user profiles

settings_def.name: enable_usersource
settings_def.label: Enable User Source
settings_def.description: Allow users to log in to DeskPRO using their Magento credentials?

settings_def.name: enable_sso
settings_def.label: Enable SSO
settings_def.description: When SSO is enabled, users will be automatically logged-in if they visit DeskPRO while they have an active Magento session.
